title: Law to limit nighttime building lighting
summary: This bill would ban nighttime interior and exterior lighting of business, office and factory buildings, with exceptions for landmark skyscrapers granted a waiver, safety lighting, occupied buildings and limited storefront and seasonal displays. Small independent stores under 4,000 square feet are exempt. Violations carry a $1,000 civil penalty, and the Department of Environmental Protection must report annually on compliance, starting the January after the law takes effect (120 days after enactment).
